discovery.subjectDiscoveryPolicy: Trusted app_metadata non-human/test plus explicit QA/acceptance purpose; no name/email inference; B2 purpose excluded

classificationPolicy: Only positively established dedicated QA content may be selected. Slug candidates and explicit associations are discovery aids, not authorization. Unknown-purpose business content is excluded.
nativePublication: Future separate official v2 publisher operation against new QA content after migration002 + app; no current v2 snapshot required for discovery
discoveryLimit: No raw titles, identities or full business content dumped. No assumption that every existing user/content record is real or test; none positively qualified.
